content: Kyber Desktop 0.27.0 already supplies direct hostname or IP launch, Kymux over QUIC, selectable H.264, HEVC, and AV1, 4:4:4 mode, fullscreen pointer confinement, relative mouse support, Linux X11 clipboard endpoints, metrics, authentication, and certificate-hash verification. Its official changelog documents macOS keyboard acquisition as experimental and X11 clipboard as new; the project context confirms that macOS NSPasteboard bridging and reliable keyboard grab remain local-patch gaps. Sources: https://gitlab.com/kyber/apps/kyber-desktop and pinned README and CHANGELOG at commit 6c75cc276e40ed9cca4e9dcabe3f7e4e1d83c44f.
